analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABRA1 is a GABA-A receptor subunit; these cell lines are non-neuronal and express little GABA-A receptor, so a chemoreceptor agonist acting at GABRA1 should produce little transcriptional response, similar to other GABA-receptor-targeting classes that also lack their receptor in these cells.
